name: 42071 · Murray, KY
findings: ZIP 42071 (Murray) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42071 (Murray) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
